# USD Learns

> > A Union School District educational technology blog providing remote learning strategies, digital tools guidance, and instructional resources for teachers and students.

USD Learns is the official blog of Union School District, documenting the district's transition to remote learning during school closures and showcasing best practices in educational technology integration. The blog features tutorials, teaching strategies, and creative engagement ideas using platforms like Google Classroom, Zoom, and Google Meet.

## Key Topics

- Remote Learning
- Google Classroom
- Zoom
- Google Meet
- Video Conferencing
- Student Engagement
- Digital Tools
- At-Home Teaching
- Argumentative Writing
- Creative Activities
- Equity & Access
- ELA Instruction
- Instructional Technology
- 8x8 Virtual Office
- ThingLink

## Video Conferencing & Communication

- [USD Learns: Zoom Settings - Revisited](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/03/zoom-settings-revisited.html): Zoom security and privacy settings guide to prevent zoommoding
- [USD Learns: Guidelines for Conducting Live Video Conferences with Students](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/03/guidelines-for-conducting-live-video.html): USD guidelines for live video conferencing with privacy and equity considerations
- [USD Learns: How-to Share a Link to Meet/Zoom in Google Classroom](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/03/how-to-share-link-to-meetzoom-in-google.html): How-to guide for sharing Google Meet and Zoom links in Google Classroom
- [USD Learns: How To Use Your School Phone FROM HOME!](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/03/how-to-use-your-school-phone-from-home.html): Technical guide for using 8x8 Virtual Office phone system from home

## Google Classroom Tutorials

- [USD Learns: Sending a message to one student in Google Classroom](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/04/sending-message-to-one-student-in.html): Tutorial for messaging individual students in Google Classroom

## Remote Teaching Strategies

- [USD Learns: At-Home Teaching](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/05/at-home-teaching.html): USD remote teaching strategies for argumentative writing and student engagement
- [USD Learns: Celebrating Your Creativity and Ideas 🎉](https://blog.unionsd.org/2020/04/creativity.html): USD creative activities and online engagement ideas using ThinkLink and Charlotte's Web
